questions.topic: What is the authoritative NFL dataset?
questions.missing: Complete independently rechecked, timestamped official game and player observations.
questions.action: Inventory each field; retrieve official gamebooks and retain exact excerpts, retrieval times and hashes.

questions.known: Historical files are available; their existence does not prove pregame availability.
questions.missing: Feature publication times and immutable prediction receipts.
questions.action: Reject every feature with known_at later than prediction_at; freeze training cutoffs.

questions.known: Research forecasts are not executable quotes.
questions.missing: Official operator odds, timestamps, limits, settlement rules and permission to collect.
questions.action: Keep price and ROI blank until authorized operator records exist.

questions.topic: Who actually replaces an absent player?
questions.known: Injury report includes practice and game statuses.
questions.missing: Official depth rank, active status, expected role, participation and replacement quality.
questions.action: Join official team depth charts, transactions and game-day inactives; do not infer a replacement from an injury.

questions.known: A held-out set reduces training/test leakage risk.
questions.missing: Locked future test outcomes and uncertainty-adjusted baseline comparisons.
questions.action: Freeze hypotheses, metric, sample/power plan and family of tests before evaluation.

questions.topic: Who funds rewards and on what terms?
questions.known: No funded competition is established by this review.
questions.missing: Budget, eligibility, jurisdiction, anti-gaming policy and approved payout rules.
questions.action: Use paper-only recognition; block monetary awards pending governance approval.

questions.known: Evaluation can overfit the validation set too.
questions.missing: Repeated prospective performance and confidence intervals.
questions.action: Estimate uncertainty, never claim luck eliminated or guaranteed profit.

suggestions.missing: Field-level official provenance and data rights.
suggestions.action: Recommended first path: build an immutable official-source registry. Acceptance: every populated observation has URL, exact excerpt, as-of time and hash.

suggestions.missing: Decision on canonical empirical NFL implementation.
suggestions.action: Publish this review hub now; retain old namespaces as historical research, not newly verified findings.

suggestions.known: Official injury report is accessible as a snapshot.
suggestions.missing: Validated automated feed, team depth charts, inactives and participation.
suggestions.action: Propose authorized scheduled collection, change alerts and hard freshness checks. Fail closed on stale or missing evidence.

suggestions.known: Singles need fewer joint-model assumptions than combinations (design rationale, not a proven edge).
suggestions.missing: Calibrated outcome distributions and executable prices.
suggestions.action: Compare simple rating and team-strength baselines on chronological holdouts before promoting complexity.

suggestions.known: Historical rankings can reward selection noise.
suggestions.missing: Locked strategy versions, prediction ledger and future outcomes.
suggestions.action: Rank eligible strategies by preregistered lower confidence bound of baseline-adjusted score; show sample size and uncertainty.

suggestions.known: Pairwise coefficients alone do not establish a multi-leg joint distribution.
suggestions.missing: Aligned leg outcomes, joint probabilities, operator combination quotes.
suggestions.action: Use held-out joint-event calibration, tail stress tests and exposure caps. Never multiply marginals without evidence.

suggestions.known: Replacement roles may change opportunities; this is a hypothesis.
suggestions.missing: Official per-game usage, role snapshots, full marginal distributions and joint outcomes.
suggestions.action: Model shared game pace and role uncertainty; test same-player and same-team overlap before any reward eligibility.

suggestions.known: This hub separates proposals from implementation.
suggestions.action: Keep status proposed / approved / rejected / implemented with rationale and version. No suggestion here changes a betting model automatically.

strategies.missing: Official historical scores, schedule context and holdout evaluation.
strategies.action: Fit home-margin and total distributions using prior-only data; report fair spread, total and win probability with uncertainty.

strategies.missing: Actual replacement role, prior usage and opponent matchup evidence.
strategies.action: Compare injury-aware model to identical injury-blind baseline; isolate incremental held-out skill.

strategies.missing: Aligned outcomes and measured cross-game dependence.
strategies.action: Validate joint hit probabilities and expected payoff against recorded operator prices.

strategies.missing: Shared game-state distribution and joint-event calibration.
strategies.action: Simulate conditional outcomes; compare joint predictions with held-out joint observations.

strategies.missing: Player usage, role, availability, official game logs and operator settlement.
strategies.action: Fit count/yardage distributions; validate tails and shared opportunities, not just average yards.

strategies.known: Mandatory proposed gate for all strategies.
strategies.action: Fail on missing provenance, permission, pregame timestamps or fresh availability.

strategies.known: Mandatory proposed gate for all strategies.
strategies.action: Freeze code, seed, data hash and strategy version; chronological validation with no same-game leakage.

strategies.known: Mandatory proposed gate for all strategies.
strategies.action: Use log loss/Brier for probabilities and distribution scoring for margins; compare with simple baseline.

strategies.known: Mandatory proposed gate for all strategies.
strategies.missing: Power plan, test-family register and untouched prospective outcomes.
strategies.action: Block bootstrap by game/week; adjust for all tried strategies; require improvement interval above zero under frozen rules.

strategies.missing: Joint outcomes, coefficients with sample sizes/CIs and joint calibration.
strategies.action: Estimate only on training folds; verify on held-out joint events, including rare-tail sensitivity.

strategies.missing: Executable odds, costs, stability by season/role, drawdown limits and funded approval.
strategies.action: No ROI or cash prize eligibility before all applicable gates pass. Missing evidence means blocked, not passed.

injuries.known: Week 10 injury page retrieved 2026-11-12; Lucas Patrick: C, Concussion, Did Not Participate In Practice, Out (Commanders).
injuries.missing: Report publication time, replacement identity and depth rank.
injuries.action: Preserve this limited excerpt; do not infer starter/backup status or a line adjustment.

injuries.known: Same retrieved page: Malik Harrison: LB, Groin, Limited Participation in Practice, Questionable (Giants).
injuries.missing: Final active status, role, backup rank and expected snaps.
injuries.action: Questionable is preserved verbatim; no numerical probability assigned.

injuries.topic: Both offensive and defensive replacement chains
injuries.known: Required schema: team, position, player, depth rank, predecessor, effective_at, known_at, official URL.
injuries.missing: Verified rank-1/2/3/4 chains and role evidence.
injuries.action: Leave ranks blank until official team evidence is acquired; never equate roster order with depth rank.

injuries.known: No defensive/offensive deficiency is established here.
injuries.missing: Opponent-adjusted impact with sample size and uncertainty.
injuries.action: Test position-specific matchup deltas, shrink small samples and separate role changes from player quality.

injuries.known: This static site is not a live injury collector.
injuries.missing: Authorized collection endpoint, rate policy, durable storage and scheduled monitoring.
injuries.action: Proposed: poll permitted reports, diff versions, reconcile IDs and suppress affected prices if stale. No active live-monitor claim.

flagged.known: nfl-quant/data/provenance.json lists nflverse and fantasydatapros archives.
flagged.action: Do not promote inherited results as official-source-only verified. See linked repository evidence.

flagged.known: nfl-lab/data/verification_report.json describes an earlier eight-week dataset.
flagged.action: Structural checks are not independent external fact verification; do not reuse old lines as current.
Leave policy requirements unverified; use accessible injury page only for observed status excerpts.

flagged.known: No coefficient, price, ROI or performance number is newly certified here.
flagged.missing: Officially sourced aligned observations and reproducible calculation.
flagged.action: Values remain blank in the metric register; inherited third-party experiments are context, not verification.

flagged.known: No strategy passes the gates in this review.
flagged.action: No funded payouts or guarantee of skill. Randomness cannot be removed from NFL outcomes.

flagged.known: Read coordination, workflow files and selected NFL source/provenance/model reports.
flagged.missing: Independent line-by-line factual recheck of every inherited namespace.
flagged.action: This is a bounded audit, not certification of the entire repository. Preserve unrelated work.
